freeze_boundary: Defined before reading the new final wrist-layout episode outputs; no result-based adjustment under this version.
scope: Recorded measured transforms, programmable RGB-D usability, current physical component visibility and conservative visual OBB bounds. Not physical D405 calibration, native contact acceptance or full simulation promotion.

optics.scope: Effective runtime K and actual frame dimensions; authored lens metadata alone cannot pass. D405 optical criteria added after a preserved640x480 pilot revealed ignored vertical aperture, before final full episodes.
optics.resolution: Use recorded per-camera dimensions; no shared640-pixel assumption. Native D455 Global optics are measured/reported separately.

visibility.visibility_attribution: Current recorded mechanical surface ranges and measured knife pose, checked against actual measured depth; no future component labels or native semantic-AOV claim.

visual_clearance.method: Separating-axis signed projection gaps of visual OBBs. A positive gap is a conservative separation lower bound; overlap requires finer inspection and is not measured native penetration.
visual_clearance.material_component_bounds: Current component AABBs reported descriptively; bounding overlap does not establish actual mesh penetration.

promotion_boundary: Report all camera/time/view measurements, including FAIL and NOT_RUN. Prototype wrist RGB-D and Lab ideal Global stay explicitly separate from native Kit D455; task-physics regression is evaluated independently.

previous_protocol.scope: Historical observation-arm visibility requirements retained for v1-v3 recordings
